key_points: Chipotlane milestone (1,500 lanes) underscores successful digital/experience innovation and operational scale, supporting long-term throughput and unit economics
Limited-time margarita revival is a modest traffic/momentum driver, unlikely to be thesis-changing on its own
Stock trading at high relative P/E (~28.7x); upside depends on continued faster growth/margin delivery versus cheaper restaurant peers
Recent price action positive (JPM $37 PT, buyback/guidance chatter) but largely reflects valuation premium and rotational setup rather than structural change
